caption: The drawing depicts a metal pitcher or watering can with a conical body, a cylindrical neck, a curved spout, and a rounded handle. The spout extends from the upper left portion of the body, curving outward and upward. The handle is attached on the right side of the body and curves outward and downward. The overall color of the pitcher appears to be rusty brown with some lighter spots, suggesting a metallic or weathered surface. To the right of the pitcher, there is a small, cylindrical object that appears to be a lid, also brown in color and matching the texture of the pitcher. Both objects are placed against a plain, light beige background with minimal details.
title: Oil Can with Spout
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
